description: The Ponte dei Salti is the double stone footbridge at Lavertezzo Valle, in the municipality of Verzasca, with two arches of about 14 metres and a humped walkway over pale granite. The right arch has stood again in stone since the 1960 rebuilding. This replaces the Lugano lakefront promenade, already published. The Open-Meteo model is clear and mild, about 16°C, with no cloud, a light wind, and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
